data.name: Drill Crew
data.detailed_description:
DRILL CREW

KEEP THE MACHINE ALIVE.

Descend deep underground with your crew aboard a massive industrial drilling machine. Every expedition is a high-risk journey where one mistake can cost everything.

Mine valuable resources, survive unexpected disasters, upgrade your machine, and make it back to the surface before the depths claim your crew.

EVERY CREW MEMBER HAS A ROLE

Success depends on teamwork.

One player scans the underground using the radar system, searching for valuable ore while avoiding hidden TNT.

Another controls the drill's direction, steering the machine through dangerous terrain.

Others repair damaged pipes, extinguish fires, transfer resources, manage fuel, and keep the machine running under extreme pressure.

No single player can be everywhere at once.

SURVIVE THE DEPTHS

The deeper you drill, the greater the rewards—and the greater the risks.

Every expedition brings new challenges.

• Random ore locations

• Hidden TNT deposits

• Pipe failures

• Machine damage

• Fuel management

• Emergency repairs

A single mistake can turn a successful expedition into a complete disaster.

BUILD A BETTER MACHINE

Return safely to the surface and sell the resources you've collected.

Use your earnings to improve every part of your drilling machine.

Upgrade drill performance, fuel efficiency, storage capacity, radar range, durability, and more to reach even greater depths.

The stronger your machine becomes, the further you can push each expedition.

EVERY EXPEDITION IS DIFFERENT

No two runs are exactly the same.

Ore deposits, TNT locations, and the challenges you'll face change from run to run, forcing your crew to adapt and work together.

Every decision matters.

Every mistake has consequences.

Every successful return means one more chance to go even deeper.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
